    # Use the URL fragment to navigate to the template section instead of clicking the link
    await page.goto('http://172.26.116.102:8081/projects/new#create_from_template')
    # Wait for the page to load and the template section to appear

    await page.get_by_role('radio', name='Private').click()

    await page.get_by_label('Project template').select_option('HTML')

    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Create project').click()

    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
